verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's source is publicly hosted on GitHub (opentofu-gh-1) and the manifesto explicitly commits to remaining 'Truly open source' now under the Linux Foundation (opentofu-docs-26); community discussion confirms the license is readily found in the GitHub repo even if not prominent on the marketing site (opentofu-comm-3). Missing for 10: explicit citation of the license text/name (e.g., MPL 2.0) and independent legal/audit confirmation beyond community mention.
